headline: Government to Buy 155,000 Metric Tons of Fertilizer from Three Countries
summary: The government will buy 155,000 tons of fertilizer, including potash and DAP, from Russia, Canada and Saudi Arabia. The imports will cost 969 crore 47 lakh taka, approved at a procurement meeting.
why: Fertilizer imports affect agricultural input costs and food production, and Bangladesh relies heavily on imported potash and phosphate fertilizers.
